title: EFC — Master Specification
description: The master formal specification of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC), defining the complete theoretical framework including the dynamical sector (EFC-D) and structural sector (EFC-S). It derives expansion, rotation curves, lensing, and light propagation from a unified entropy-driven energy-flow field without requiring dark matter or dark energy.

effective_potential.description: Effective gravitational-like potential built from the energy-flow field and entropy level, with coupling exponent beta (baseline beta=1).

expansion_rate.description: Effective expansion rate derived from energy-flow magnitude and thermodynamic entropy modulation; late-time acceleration emerges without dark energy.

rotation_velocity.description: Circular velocity from the gradient of the entropy-coupled effective potential; flat rotation curves emerge as thermodynamic signatures without dark matter.

effective_light_speed.description: Entropy-dependent effective speed of light, where x(S) = (S - S_mid)/(Delta S/2) is the normalized entropy coordinate.

light_travel_time.description: Observed light-travel time integrated along photon path gamma with the entropy-varying speed of light.

energy_flow_field.description: The scalar energy-flow field aligns with the negative entropy gradient, encoding energy transport along entropy-driven channels.

key_results.main_finding: A complete cosmological framework is specified in which expansion, rotation curves, lensing, and light propagation all emerge from a single entropy-driven energy-flow field without invoking dark matter or dark energy.

sealed_predictions.statement: Flat rotation curves arise from the entropy-coupled potential gradient without any non-baryonic dark-matter component.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Observation of galactic rotation curves whose shape cannot be reproduced by any entropy-field configuration within EFC-D.

sealed_predictions.statement: Late-time cosmic acceleration emerges from the evolution of (Ef, S) without an external dark-energy term.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Demonstration that the EFC expansion-rate functional form H(Ef,S) cannot fit supernova Ia or BAO distance-ladder data at competitive chi-squared.

sealed_predictions.statement: Mid-entropy regions produce maximum light-travel-time delays (minimum effective c), creating a stability band for halo-like structures.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Time-delay measurements across entropy-gradient regions showing no correlation with the predicted c(S) profile.

kill_criteria: KC1: Rotation-curve fits from the EFC potential gradient are statistically worse (delta-chi2 > 4 per galaxy) than standard NFW dark-matter halo fits across a representative galaxy sample.
KC2: The EFC expansion rate H(Ef,S) cannot reproduce the observed Hubble parameter evolution H(z) within 3-sigma of current BAO + SN Ia constraints.
KC3: Lensing observations show convergence profiles incompatible with the dual-lens (s0 focusing / s1 defocusing) prediction of the entropy field.
KC4: Direct detection of a dark-matter particle confirmed by two independent experiments, removing the primary motivation for an entropy-based alternative.
KC5: The entropy-dependent light speed c(S) is ruled out by laboratory or astrophysical measurements constraining speed-of-light variation below the a_edge level.
